description: This file defines enums, interfaces, and functions related to permission management, including resource types, actions, permission validation, and a permission registry for a software project.

methods.name: parsePermissionString
methods.description: Parses a permission string into its resource and action components

methods.name: isValidPermissionString
methods.description: Validates the format of a permission string

methods.name: filterResourceConfig
methods.description: Filters out the _resource property from a ResourceConfig object

methods.name: getPermissionsForScope
methods.description: Filters permission registry based on scope and team privacy

methods.name: getAllPermissionStringsForScope
methods.description: Returns all permission strings available for a given scope

methods.name: isValidPermissionStringForScope
methods.description: Checks if a permission string is valid within a specific scope
